name: property-card
title: Property card
description: A home listing as a card: a gallery of photos with arrows, the price in tabular numerals, the address, bedrooms, bathrooms and area with units, a status and a save toggle.
docs: images is { src, alt }[]: the first is on show, they scroll with native snapping (swipe, trackpad) or with the two arrows, which loop and appear on hover and focus, and a counter says which photo you are on; from the keyboard the gallery itself is one tab stop and the left and right arrow keys step through it (the arrow buttons are for the pointer and for screen readers); one photo has no arrows and none shows a quiet placeholder. Every photo needs an alt, which is what the gallery reads out. price is a number written in currency (default EUR) and locale as tabular numerals with no cents, or your own words (€2,150 / month). facts is { beds, baths, area, plot } and is written with its units as a labelled list (3 beds, 2 baths, 142 m², 310 m² plot): for square feet set labels.area to {count} sq ft. status is for-sale, under-offer, sold or new, a badge in a word on the first photo; a sold listing is muted (black and white photos, a quiet price). The address is the one link of the card (href, or onOpen for a button) and a tap or click on a photo opens it too, while the arrows and the heart are separate targets above it. The heart is a toggle with aria-pressed whose name carries the address (Save Prinsengracht 214, Amsterdam): saved controls it (or defaultSaved lets the card keep it) and onSave(next) reports it. labels carries every word.
